grants.description: Verify your identity and relationship to the licence holder
grants.purpose: To confirm you are authorized to cancel this driving licence

grants.description: Share the driving licence details to be cancelled
grants.purpose: To identify and cancel the correct driving licence record

grants.description: Share death certificate details or Tell Us Once reference
grants.purpose: To verify the death of the licence holder and process cancellation

grants.description: Provide the reason for cancelling the driving licence
grants.purpose: To record why the licence is being cancelled and process accordingly

grants.description: Confirm whether the physical licence card will be returned to DVLA
grants.purpose: To track the physical licence card and ensure proper disposal

revocation.mechanism: Contact DVLA before notification is submitted. After submission, cancellation cannot be reversed.
revocation.effect: If consent is revoked before submission, the cancellation will not be processed. After submission, the licence remains cancelled.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot cancel a licence without explicit confirmation from an authorized person. Agent cannot override edge case handoffs (active court ban, medical review). Agent cannot process cancellations for medical reasons - these must be reported through medical review process.
